messages:
anita: Heads-up: support case INC-4521 reporting sustained p99 > 1.2s for text.gen in us-west since 08:20 UTC. Customer saw error spikes and timeouts. Posting traces + initial metrics.

dmitri: saw the alert too. p95 up ~300ms and p99 jump is big. Any recent deploys to prefix/kvcache?

mike: nope no infra deploys in the last 6h. Runtime had a config flip on eviction policy at 07:55 for a canary — might be related.

jordan: grabbing traces. stack shows a lot of KV cache misses and rehydration stalls on GPU hot paths. pattern: many near-identical keys but with different normalization (trailing spaces / case).

anita: that matches the customer repro — they send templated prompts with slight whitespace differences. Could be key normalization bug introduced in key hashing change.

dmitri: logs (sanitized):

```
[08:22:14] kv::get miss key="user:123|prompt:Hello"
[08:22:14] kv::get miss key="user:123|prompt:Hello \"\""
[08:22:14] kv::set key="user:123|prompt:Hello" size=12kb
[08:22:14] kv::evict key="user:456|..." reason=cache_pressure
[08:22:15] runtime: kvcache_rehydrate latency=65ms
[08:22:16] runtime: generate tokLatency p99=1.35s
```

mike: oof — repeated misses for semantically identical prefixes will cause hot-key spill and thrash. ttl-based eviction + small shard sizes would kick hot items out. What eviction policy did the canary toggle?

jordan: switched from LFU->TTL-weighted LRU-ish in canary. The new policy favors recency over frequency which hurts workloads with microbursts of slightly-different keys.

anita: TL;DR: normalization mismatch + eviction change => cache warmup fails and hotset spills causing p99 regressions.

dmitri: repro steps from customer: send 50 concurrent requests with base prompt and add 0-3 random trailing spaces, seq len ~120. After ~2000 reqs p99 spikes. I can reproduce locally with a small cluster sim.

mike: can you paste the minimal repro script?

dmitri: sure:

```bash
for i in {1..2000}; do
  tail=$(shuf -n1 -e "" " " "  " )
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d "{\"prompt\": \"Hello${tail}\"}" &
done
```

jordan: mitigation ideas: 1) rollback canary eviction change to previous LFU config (fast) 2) patch key normalization to canonicalize whitespace/case before hashing (medium) 3) increase shard cache size + pin hot keys temporarily (fast) 4) add client-side request coalescing for identical prefix window (longer).

anita: I opened support ticket INC-4521 and set severity P1 for customer SLAs. Sending an ops page to oncall.

oncall-ops: oncall here. Prioritize rollback to LFU on canary nodes while we validate normalization patch. I'll schedule a 10% immediate rollback in us-west.

mike: I'll prepare the rollback runbook:
- identify canary hostset tag=kv-canary-evict-2026-07
- deploy config revert to LFU in staging, run load test
- roll back 10% in us-west, observe p99 for 30m
- if improvement, continue progressive rollback

dmitri: I've got a candidate patch that normalizes keys with `.trim()` and lowercasing, plus collapsing multiple spaces. Quick PR ready: #3142.

jordan: let's not rush normalization across all clusters — potential subtlety with tokenized prompt-level semantics. Patch should be gated behind a toggle.
anita: agreed. Plan: quick rollback to LFU now, enable pinning for hot keys for affected customer, merge PR behind toggle and canary only after correctness tests.

mike: rolling back 10% now — starting change at 08:40 UTC. watch p99.

dmitri: local repro after LFU revert shows p99 back to baseline (~320ms). Good sign.
jordan: customer confirmed improved latencies within 12 minutes of rollback: "Thanks — latency looks normal now". Marking as mitigation success for now.

anita: follow-ups:
- QA: run normalized-key correctness tests across prompt templates (assigned dmitri)
- Infra: evaluate shard sizing and increase default kvcache_shard_size in us-west by +20% (assigned mike)
- Product: notify customers that whitespace/case variants can affect warmed caches and we'll add docs (assigned jordan)

oncall-ops: creating incident postmortem ticket PM-4521 and will attach timeline + metrics. If anyone has other repro artifacts drop here.

mike: will also add a short-term circuit: if miss rate > 12% for a hot model route for >10m, auto-pin top-100 hot keys to avoid spill. I'll prototype today.

dmitri: PR #3142 pushed behind toggle: kvcache.normalize_keys = true (off by default). QA will run canary tomorrow after tests.

anita: thanks everyone. Closing the immediate escalation — keeping thread open until PR is validated and infra changes merged. :white_check_mark:
